answer_2.quote: Automatically evaluating these issues can not only provide effective loss functions for training generative models to enhance their performance but also filter out low-quality generated images during inference, thereby improving user experience.

answer_3.quote: Recently, pre-trained Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated powerful semantic understanding and reasoning capabilities, exhibiting higher correlation with human judgments. This has promoted researchers to develop MLLM-based automatic evaluation methods.

answer_4.quote: three human annotators are asked to annotate the evaluations for each pair of text prompt and image, following our proposed task decomposition evaluation framework.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate generated images from visual appearance, intrinsic properties, and relational attributes, assigning scores and providing explanations.
